units.source_text: 薰大将拿出山庄中原有的七弦琴和筝来，

en.t: Kaoru, the Captain, brought out the seven-stringed koto and the zither that had long been in the mountain villa,

units.source_text: 想起浮舟对此道必然更无知识，实甚可惜，

en.t: and, thinking it a great pity that Ukifune must know even less about such arts,

units.source_text: 只得独自一人弹奏。

en.t: had no choice but to play by himself.

units.source_text: 自从八亲王逝世之后，薰大将久不在此奏乐了，

en.t: Since Prince Hachi had passed away, Kaoru had not made music here for a long time,

units.source_text: 今日重温旧梦，自觉颇饶佳趣。

en.t: and now, reviving old memories, he found the moment deeply charming.

units.source_text: 正在乘兴鼓弦，心驰神往之际，

en.t: Just as he was playing the strings with growing delight, his thoughts carried far away,

units.source_text: 月亮出来了。

en.t: the moon came out.

units.source_text: 他回想八亲王弹出琴声，并非锋芒毕露，

en.t: He remembered how Prince Hachi's playing of the koto had not been showy or sharp-edged,

units.source_text: 却很悠扬婉转，沁人心肺，

en.t: but was instead graceful, lingering, and deeply moving,

units.source_text: 便对浮舟说道：“当年你父亲和大姐在世之时，

en.t: and then he said to Ukifune, "In those days, when your father and elder sister were alive,

units.source_text: 你倘也在此地生长，今日你必更多理解人生情趣。

en.t: if you too had grown up here, today you would understand far more of life's refinements.

units.source_text: 八亲王的风度，即使是像我这样的外客，

en.t: Prince Hachi's bearing was such that even an outsider like me

units.source_text: 也觉得和蔼可亲，恋恋不舍。

en.t: found him warm and approachable, and could hardly bear to leave him.

units.source_text: 你为什么长年住在乡僻地方呢？”

en.t: Why did you spend so many years living in a remote country place?"

units.source_text: 浮舟被问，深感羞愧，

en.t: When Ukifune was asked this, she felt deeply ashamed,

units.source_text: 默默地斜倚着，手弄白扇。

en.t: and leaned to one side in silence, toying with a white fan in her hands.

units.source_text: 但见她的侧影，肌肤洁白如玉，

en.t: Looking at her profile, he saw that her skin was as white as jade,

units.source_text: 额发低垂如画，

en.t: and the hair over her forehead hung low like something in a painting,

units.source_text: 这神情竟和大女公子一模一样。

en.t: so that her expression was astonishingly identical to that of the elder princess.

units.source_text: 薰大将深为感动，越发想把丝竹之事好好地教会她，

en.t: Kaoru was deeply moved and wanted all the more to teach her music properly,

units.source_text: 使她适合身份，便问她：“这七弦琴你也略懂得些么？

en.t: so that she would befit her station, and he asked her, "Do you know a little about this seven-stringed koto too?

units.source_text: 你长住吾妻地方，吾妻的琴总会弹吧？”

en.t: Since you lived for so long in Azuma, surely you can play the Azuma koto?"

units.source_text: 浮舟答道：“我连那大和词也不大懂得，

en.t: Ukifune answered, "I do not even understand Yamato words very well,

units.source_text: 何况大和琴。”

en.t: much less the Yamato koto."

units.source_text: 薰大将见她回答得巧妙，觉得此女才情不坏。

en.t: Seeing how cleverly she answered, Kaoru thought that the young woman had no small talent.

units.source_text: 因念把她放在这里，不能随意前来相会，终非善策。

en.t: He then reflected that leaving her here, where he could not come to meet her freely, was after all no good plan.

units.source_text: 他深感今后相思之苦，

en.t: He felt keenly the pain of longing that awaited him from now on,

units.source_text: 可见他对浮舟的爱情非寻常可比。

en.t: which showed that his love for Ukifune was no ordinary attachment.

units.source_text: 他把七弦琴推开，口中吟诵“楚王台上夜琴声”的古诗。

en.t: He pushed the seven-stringed koto aside and recited the old line, "Atop King Chu's terrace, the sound of a koto at night."

units.source_text: 在只讲弯弓射箭的东国地方长大起来的侍从，

en.t: The serving women, who had grown up in the eastern provinces where people spoke only of bending bows and shooting arrows,

units.source_text: 听了这吟声也觉得非常美妙，极口赞叹。

en.t: heard his recitation and found it extremely beautiful, praising it unstintingly.

units.source_text: 可知她们不懂得上一句诗中所咏

en.t: This showed that they did not understand what the preceding line of the poem alluded to,

units.source_text: 班婕妤看见秋扇而伤心的故事，

en.t: the story of Ban Jieyu grieving when she saw an autumn fan,

units.source_text: 而只是叹赏吟声的优美，见识也太浅了。

en.t: and merely admired the beauty of his chanting, showing how shallow their understanding was.

units.source_text: 薰大将想道：“可吟诵的诗句甚多，

en.t: Kaoru thought, "There are so many lines of poetry I might recite,

units.source_text: 我为什么偏偏取这不吉的句子呢？”

en.t: so why did I choose this ominous one of all things?"

units.source_text: 此时老尼姑派人送果物来了。

en.t: Just then the old nun sent someone with fruit.

units.source_text: 一个盒盖中铺着些红叶和常春藤，

en.t: On the lid of a box, some red leaves and ivy had been spread out,

units.source_text: 其间巧妙地布置着种种果物。

en.t: and among them various fruits were arranged with skill.

units.source_text: 衬在下面的纸上草率地写着一首诗，

en.t: On the paper laid underneath, a poem had been written in a casual hand,

units.source_text: 在明朗的月光之下显露出来。

en.t: and it stood out clearly under the bright moonlight.

units.source_text: 薰大将注目观看，好像急于想吃果物的样子。

en.t: Kaoru gazed at it intently, looking as though he were impatient to eat the fruit.

units.source_text: 老尼姑的诗是：

en.t: The old nun's poem was as follows:
